2026-09-21.patch_summary: The patch optimizes the blk-cgroup subsystem by skipping unnecessary rstat flush operations for cgroups without block groups (blkg). This is achieved by checking if the blkg list is empty before flushing the rstat subtree, reducing CPU usage and improving performance. The change is based on the hierarchical nature of blkg creation, where a descendant blkg implies an ancestor blkg on the same device.
